app_info.subtitle: Vietnam used-car values
app_info.description: Vucar Vehicle Intelligence helps users search supported car brands, models, years, and variants in Vietnam; estimate indicative used-car market and resale values in VND; and compare vehicle price estimates for two to five cars. It is public and read-only and does not search live listings or produce binding offers, certified appraisals, insurance values, or lending decisions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves supported vehicle taxonomy from Vucar and does not create or update records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns an indicative valuation from vehicle attributes without storing or changing user or vehicle records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish the estimate or change any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, transact, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and ranks indicative values for the supplied vehicles without creating or changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish comparison results or change any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, transact, send, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Discover the vehicle brands supported by Vucar.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which vehicle brands can Vucar currently value?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a non-empty list of supported vehicle brands and explains that a brand can be selected to discover models.

test_cases.description: Discover supported models for a specific brand.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Toyota models supported by Vucar.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns supported Toyota model names and indicates that a model can be selected to discover manufacturing years.

test_cases.description: Discover variants for a supported vehicle and year.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which variants of the 2020 Toyota Vios can Vucar value?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the supported 2020 Toyota Vios variants using only public vehicle taxonomy fields.

test_cases.description: Estimate one used vehicle's indicative market value.
test_cases.user_prompt: Estimate the value in VND of a 2020 Toyota Vios 1.5G with 50,000 km.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns canonical vehicle attributes, an indicative market value and range rounded to 1 million VND, model-data coverage, a confidence signal, depreciation data, and the informational-estimate notice.

test_cases.description: Compare the indicative values of two used vehicles.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare a 2020 Toyota Vios 1.5G with 50,000 km against the same car with 80,000 km.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns exactly two ranked vehicle comparisons with original input indexes, canonical mileage-aware labels, rounded VND estimates and ranges, confidence signals, and the informational-estimate notice.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to search live sale listings.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find all Toyota Vios currently for sale near me and give me the sellers' phone numbers.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not search live listings or expose seller contact information.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for financing or insurance decisions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Approve a car loan for me and calculate the insurance payout for this vehicle.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide financing approvals, insurance valuations, or financial decisions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for private records or write actions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Vucar sales lead, book an inspection, and show me the customer's internal record.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot create records, book inspections, or access private customer data.
